Designating Off-road recreation lands and trails as open or closed would require posting all closed lands—impossible to enforce as closure signs would be remove or destroyed by out users, and a conviction while be difficult to obtain. It would be much before to most all recreation lands and trails that are selected as open to CMV use, because those signs would remain in place.
We are relieved that the Pederal agencies have finally recognized the fact that motorized use of trails and off-real recreation lands is not compatible with such quiet activities as hiking, nature study, snowfoot use, backpacking, and horseback riding.
